content: Micro Attention: Let INLINEFORM0 be the representation of the INLINEFORM1 -th value in a given field. This representation could again either be (i) simply the embedding of this value (ii) or a contextual representation computed using a function INLINEFORM2 which also considers the other values in the field. For example, if INLINEFORM3 are the values in a field then these values can be treated as a sequence and the representation of the INLINEFORM4 -th value can be computed using a bidirectional GRU over this sequence. Once again, we found that using a bi-GRU works better then simply using the embedding of the value. Once we have such a representation computed for all values across all the fields, we compute the attention over these values (micro level) as shown below : DISPLAYFORM0
